Callout.Name: Dead Drop - Watched Address
Callout.Message: Address watched, believed to be used for exchanges.
Callout.Advisory: No persons present, bench in the open.

Script.Line: I sit on this bench because it is out of the wind.
I have not left anything and I have not picked anything up.
You can watch me all day. I am not going anywhere.

Lines.Approach: Somebody leaves something and somebody else picks it up. We have not caught either of them yet.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
